posts.mainText: Chatham House paper reveals AI governance deadlock from geopolitical misalignments, likely broken only by crisis forcing global coordination via existing institutions.
posts.replyText: Pre-crisis prep ensures legitimate, enforceable coordination post-crisis, avoiding ad-hoc failures undermining global AI order.

posts.mainText: SHRM releases AI white paper urging human-centric governance, workforce upskilling amid 89% HR efficiency gains, calling for federal risk-based framework.
posts.replyText: Aligns innovation, readiness, governance with federal guardrails to prevent bias, build trust, ensure consistent standards in workforce AI adoption.

posts.mainText: Survey shows Americans prioritize trust in AI governance: 90% back child safety, 87% accountability; trust independent experts most for oversight.
posts.replyText: Highlights legitimacy via third-party experts over govt/industry; public splits on intl coordination vs US leadership, informing policy design.

posts.mainText: GNI urges WSIS Forum 2026 to focus on action, rights-based AI governance, aligning with Global Digital Compact via multistakeholder processes.
posts.replyText: Promotes inclusive coordination integrating AI summits and UN dialogues for implementation-focused, human rights-grounded global AI efforts.

posts.mainText: MAP-AI delivers oral inputs to UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance, stressing inclusive participation, accountability, human rights pillars.
posts.replyText: Pushes equitable Global Majority role, cross-framework coordination like WSIS/IGF for multistakeholder AI safety alignment.
